values.meaning: bonus true damage on basic attacks

mechanics.claim: Corki's basic attacks deal bonus true damage equal to 20% AD, affected by critical strike modifiers.
mechanics.quote: '''Corki's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} deal {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' true damage}}}} equal to {{as|20% AD}}. This damage is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.

mechanics.claim: The true damage and physical damage are two simultaneous instances, with true damage dealt first.
mechanics.quote: The mixed damage is dealt in two simultaneous instances of damage, but will pretend to be a single instance for most effects

mechanics.claim: Both damage instances natively apply life steal.
mechanics.quote: Both instances deal {{tip|basic damage}} and thus natively apply {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}.

mechanics.claim: On-hit effects only apply once, at the start of the attack.
mechanics.quote: The attack applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects only once, right at the start.

mechanics.claim: If the target dies from the true damage, the physical damage still applies; but if it dies from on-hit damage, the true damage is skipped.
mechanics.quote: Even if the target dies from the {{as|true damage}}, the {{as|physical damage}} will still be applied to it.
